milestone: Provide a reviewed saved-output evaluator before any joint-model arm runs.
decision_changed: Whether K9 benchmark outputs can be scored without exact-key, pooled-river, clock, placement, split, merge, or overlap-accounting errors.
cheapest_adequate_test: Synthetic saved-array known answers with adversarial timing, spatial, split, merge, decoy, overlap, clock and null cases.
completion_condition: All known-answer fixtures pass, an immutable source/contract snapshot is independently reviewed, and no scientific arm output has been inspected.
input_domain: saved arrays only; no recording, voltage, sorter, DARTsort or GPU access

matching.scope: each truth unit against each output cluster independently
matching.algorithm: deterministic maximum-cardinality bipartite matching over pairs passing both gates
matching.spatial_gate: required explicit spatial_tolerance_um in each evaluation specification; compares truth per-event placement with output per-event placement

chance_controls.method: explicit pre-frozen circular session-clock shifts, same matching statistic and spatial support
chance_controls.above_chance_rule: observed matched count strictly exceeds the maximum shifted-null matched count

reported_endpoints.recovery: per-truth-unit TP/FP/FN, accuracy and best output cluster
reported_endpoints.split: number and identities of output clusters with >5% capture and observed matches above every frozen shifted null
reported_endpoints.many_to_one: truth units sharing one best output cluster, separately reported
reported_endpoints.merge: best cluster captures another truth unit above the same capture and null rules
reported_endpoints.overlap: detection, best-cluster assignment, frame assignment, amplitude error and supplied residual-energy change reported separately
reported_endpoints.frames: probe-fixed recall, tissue-fixed retention, false probe-fixed rate and decoy false-merge rate
reported_endpoints.background: caller-supplied baseline/candidate real-unit counts and amplitude summaries, never imputed
reported_endpoints.cost: caller-supplied runtime and peak-memory receipts, never inferred

fail_closed: missing spatial tolerance or null shifts
unsorted arrays are normalized stably and their original order is retained in match receipts
interpretation: Fixture PASS establishes evaluator plumbing and arithmetic only. It cannot establish benchmark validity, arm benefit, biological identity, purity, H1 readiness, or authorization to launch a medium arm.
exclusions: no real joint-model comparison output inspection before independent review
